encode.--secret: Secret key for HMAC algorithms (HS256, HS384, HS512)
encode.--private-key: RSA, ECDSA, or EdDSA private key in PEM format for asymmetric algorithms
encode.--algorithm: Algorithm to use (falls back to config `default_algorithm`, then HS256)
encode.--compress: Compress payload using DEFLATE compression (adds "zip":"DEF" header)
encode.--jwe: Create JWE (JSON Web Encryption) token instead of JWT

verify.--secret: Secret key for HMAC algorithms (HS256, HS384, HS512)
verify.--private-key: RSA, ECDSA, or EdDSA private key in PEM format for asymmetric algorithms

crack.--mode: Cracking mode, you can use 'dict' or 'brute' [default: dict]
crack.--wordlist-preset: Download & use a numbered preset wordlist for dictionary attacks (1=raft-medium-words, 2=raft-large-words, 3=jwt-secrets). Cached under the config dir; re-download is skipped when the cached copy matches
crack.--preset: Character set preset (for bruteforce attack): az, AZ, aZ, 19, aZ19, ascii
crack.--target-field: Target a specific JWT field for brute-force (e.g., kid, jti)
crack.--pattern: Pattern template for targeted field values (use {} as placeholder, e.g., "../../keys/{}")

payload.--jwk-trust: A trusted domain for jku&x5u (e.g google.com)
payload.--jwk-attack: An attack payload domain for jku&x5u (e.g hahwul.com)
payload.--public-key: Server public key (PEM literal or file path) — forges a fully signed RS/ES→HS alg-confusion HMAC token using the key bytes as the secret

scan.--report: Export scan report to a file (JSON/HTML based on file extension)
scan.--wordlist: Wordlist file for checking weak secrets (default: common passwords)
scan.--max-crack-attempts: Maximum number of secrets to test during weak secret check [default: 100]

jwks.--algorithm: Algorithm for the spoofed key (RS256, RS384, RS512, PS256, PS384, PS512) [default: RS256]
jwks.--kid: Key ID (kid) for the spoofed key
jwks.--token: JWT token to re-sign with the spoofed key
jwks.--attacker-url: Attacker URL for jku/x5u header injection (generates full attack payloads)
jwks.--output: Output file path for the generated JWKS JSON
jwks.--jwks-file: Path to a local JWKS JSON file
jwks.--key: Individual key file paths (can be specified multiple times)

server.--api-key: API key to secure the REST API (validated against X-API-KEY header)

help.text:
Hack the JWT (JSON Web Token) - A tool for JWT security testing and token manipulation

Usage: jwt-hack [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  decode   Decodes a JWT token and displays its header, payload, and validation info
  encode   Encodes JSON data into a JWT token with specified algorithm and signing options
  verify   Verifies a JWT token's signature and optionally validates its expiration claim
  crack    Attempts to crack a JWT token using dictionary or bruteforce methods
  payload  Generates various JWT attack payloads for security testing
  scan     Scans a JWT token for common vulnerabilities and security issues
  jwks     Manages JWKS (JSON Web Key Set) operations: fetch, spoof, verify, and key rotation testing
  version  Displays version information and project details
  mcp      Runs jwt-hack as an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server
  shell    Starts an interactive shell for JWT operations
  server   Starts a REST API server for JWT operations
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --config <CONFIG>  Path to configuration file
      --json             Output JSON to stdout (pipeline-friendly)
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version
